optionMeanings: 复制数据库内容到只读副本，读请求分散到多个副本
让所有读请求都回主库，不做分散
读请求到缓存但缓存无法处理所有查询
optionScenarioImpacts: 读负载分散，主库只处理写，高QPS读可以横向扩展
主库变瓶颈，无法扩展读吞吐
optionDirectness: 只读副本是读扩展的标准做法
optionMeanings_en: Replicate database to read-only replicas; scatter read requests across replicas
Let all reads go to primary; no scattering
Read requests to cache but cache cannot handle all queries
Do not read data at all
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Read load scattered; primary only handles writes; high-QPS reads can scale horizontally
Primary becomes bottleneck; cannot scale read throughput
optionDirectness_en: Read replicas standard pattern for read scaling

optionMeanings: 事务写入主库后，副本异步复制，短时间内读到陈旧数据
optionScenarioImpacts: 可能读到几毫秒前的旧值，对大多数业务可接受
optionDirectness: 副本延迟是read replication的常见权衡
optionMeanings_en: Write to primary then async replicate; read gets stale data briefly
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Might read few-millisecond-old value; acceptable for most business
optionDirectness_en: Replica lag common tradeoff in read replication
